title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Hydrogen with 2.5x speed boost, four reasoning levels
summary: Google has rolled out Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a new artificial intelligence model that completes tasks 2.5 times faster than its predecessor, Gemini 3.8 Flash, as the company looks to improve the speed and efficiency of everyday AI tasks, coding and agentic workflows.
llm_summary: Google has introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, its latest AI model that’s 2.5 × faster than the previous Gemini 3.8 Flash. The speed boost is aimed at making everyday AI tasks—like coding, content creation, and agent‑driven workflows—more responsive and efficient for users.
